notes: Version 2.11: Songs and videos get four ways to play, so if one way fails the next one tries, and the video can always play inside the page. Media Player now lives only in Settings, Others. Media screen has Online and Offline at the top and Audio, Video, Radio tabs at the bottom; Offline shows only your phone's own songs and videos. Home is clean now: search, time, weather, gold price, and a For you feed of news and videos. No feature appears in two places anymore. Updates now come from GitHub.
